evidence: Workbook quality/internal row 8 requires substantive build work; skill quality-checks.md:33-35 asks for the smallest submission satisfying the brief. Frozen task/instruction.md:1,3,5,9,11,13 requires a server and durable database, six operational surfaces, derived compensation, approval, two linked revisions, rescission, immutable history and restart retention. hireops_rules.md:230-249 requires approval to mint linked financial effects and revision to preserve the predecessor while posting new commitments; sections 6-8 add distinct vesting, authorization and atomicity. These cannot be satisfied by a static page or one CRUD screen. The source-level stub challenge is explicitly excluded by tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 and tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25: real UI creation of both linked records and a fresh Auditor-context read are prerequisite. Functional judge.toml:263,308,335,794 separately requires successful authorized actions, live budget enforcement and fresh-write restart survival. A conforming alternative using different route names, selectors, schema or layout is expressly accepted by constraints/judge.toml:24-25 and the public rules' screen/route discretion, so this row does not depend on copying the golden. All 69 manifest-listed frozen task/rules hashes matched. This is a source-level assessment of requested product substance, not a measured configured-judge score or runtime clearance.
counterexample: Consider a polished dashboard backed by static seed JSON, or a browser-local requisition/offer form with success toasts. Neither satisfies the public lifecycle/persistence requirements; the separate-context retrieval gate expressly rejects those mocks. A full conforming app with alternative routes and vertically stacked details remains admissible under the route/layout-neutral instructions.
